title: Reading Between the Lines
text:
Many readers assume that a writer's opinion is easy to spot. In reality, stance is often conveyed through subtle choices, such as hedging words like 'perhaps' or 'arguably', and through evaluative adjectives like 'striking' or 'dubious'. A writer who writes 'the data suggests' presents a claim more cautiously than one who writes 'the data proves'.

Consider the difference between 'the policy failed' and 'the policy, regrettably, failed'. The second version reveals the writer's disappointment, even though the factual content is identical. Readers who notice these signals can judge the writer's position more accurately than those who focus only on the facts.

questions.text: What examples of hedging words does the first paragraph give?
What does the second version of the sentence contain that the first one does not?
What can the reader infer about the claim made with 'the data suggests' compared with 'the data proves'?
options: The writer is certain of the claim in both sentences
The writer is less confident with 'proves' than with 'suggests'
The writer makes a more cautious claim with 'suggests'
The writer is describing a different set of data

questions.text: Why does the author suggest that readers who notice signals can judge a writer's position more accurately?
options: Because facts are always more reliable than opinions
Because writers rarely use hedging words
Because readers can check every fact in the text
Because stance can be revealed through word choice, not only through facts

vocabulary.definition: small and not easy to notice
using words that make a statement less certain
showing a judgement about how good or bad something is
in a way that shows sadness or disappointment

paragraph_translations: Багато читачів вважають, що думку автора легко помітити. Насправді позицію часто передають тонкі мовні вибори, наприклад пом'якшувальні слова на кшталт 'perhaps' чи 'arguably', а також оцінні прикметники на кшталт 'striking' чи 'dubious'. Автор, який пише 'the data suggests', подає твердження обережніше, ніж той, хто пише 'the data proves'.

Порівняйте 'the policy failed' і 'the policy, regrettably, failed'. Друга версія показує розчарування автора, хоча фактичний зміст однаковий. Читачі, які помічають такі сигнали, можуть точніше визначити позицію автора, ніж ті, хто звертає увагу лише на факти.
